42cd8df85cd1f4c8af04a4467fca81981d1c6fa7.summary: Not a threat report: this is a court service-of-process notice. Google LLC has sued Does 1-25 over alleged BadBox 2.0 malware that forms a botnet of infected internet-connected devices used for cybercrime. A temporary injunction was granted, and Google plans to seek a preliminary injunction. The notice tells defendants to respond within 21 days.
hedges: Google alleges that Defendants have deployed BadBox 2.0 malware to form a botnet and use illicit access to commit cybercrimes.
